descripcion: Un titular enorme, tipográfico y alineado a la izquierda ocupa el 60-70% del lienzo sobre un fondo plano de color de marca, con una sola palabra clave resaltada en el color de acento. El producto aparece pequeño en la esquina inferior derecha y una línea corta de apoyo cierra abajo a la izquierda. Es un freno de scroll puro: la frase hace todo el trabajo y el producto solo firma.
reference_style: Bold editorial typographic ad: an oversized, tightly set headline on a flat brand-colored background, with the product as a small sign-off in the corner

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The giant headline, read as one solid block of type that dominates the canvas. 2) The single highlighted key word inside the headline. 3) The small product in the bottom-right corner. 4) The short support line at the bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Left-aligned, top-weighted typographic composition. The headline block runs from the 7% top margin down to about 66-68% of the canvas height and spans about 86% of the width (from 7% to 93%), set in 3-4 stacked lines, so the type mass fills roughly two thirds of the canvas. Below it, a footer zone from about 72% to 93% of the canvas height: support line on the left, product on the right, both bottom-aligned at about 93%.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Safe margins of about 7% on every side. Tight line spacing in the headline (leading about 0.95-1.0 of the font size) so the lines read as one block. A clear gap of about 4-5% of the canvas height between the last headline line and the top of the footer zone. Nothing else on the canvas; the empty background is part of the design.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat graphic design. The background is a solid brand color with at most a barely visible paper grain or soft vignette. The only depth is on the product: soft studio light, a crisp contact shadow and a faint drop shadow so it sits on the flat color like a real object.

layout_summary: Square canvas with a flat brand-colored background. A huge left-aligned headline in 3-4 stacked lines fills the top and middle of the canvas (from the 7% top margin to about 67% of the height, edge to edge between the side margins), with one key word highlighted by the accent color or a hand-drawn marker swipe behind it. In the bottom footer zone (about 72-93% of the height): a short support text at the bottom left and the product, small (about 18-22% of the canvas height), standing in the bottom-right corner with a soft shadow. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Flat, bold color field that leaves the giant type as the only thing to look at
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Fill with one solid color from the approved palette (usually the primary or the most saturated/darkest tone) with at most a barely visible grain or soft vignette. No photos, no patterns, no multi-color gradients.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left, from the 7% top margin down to about 66-68% of the canvas height, spanning about 86% of the canvas width (7% to 93%)
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The scroll-stopper itself: the statement is the visual
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Set the angle's hook as 3-4 stacked lines of huge type that fill the block edge to edge; break lines by meaning so each line lands as a punch. Scale the font so the block keeps its 60-70% footprint whatever the word count.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the headline, on its single most emotional key word
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Directs the eye to the word that carries the emotion of the angle
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Highlight exactly one word or short phrase: either recolor it in the brand accent or place a hand-drawn marker/brush swipe in the accent color behind it, with the text kept fully legible. Never highlight more than one item.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom-left footer zone, aligned with the headline's left edge, its last line ending at about 91-93% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Connects the statement to the product in a quiet second read
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short sentence (max 2 lines) based on what the product is or what it solves. Keep it within the left 50% of the canvas so it never touches the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom-right corner inside the safe margin, base at about 93% of the canvas height; about 18-22% of the canvas height and no more than 25% of the canvas width
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Signs off the statement and shows what is being sold without competing with the type
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), standing upright or at a slight 3/4 angle, with a crisp contact shadow on the flat background. Keep it small; it must never overlap the headline.

text_layers.reference_position: Top-left, from the 7% top margin to about 67% of the height, filling about 86% of the width
text_layers.text_style: Ultra-bold (black weight) sans-serif with tight letter-spacing, huge: each line about 13-17% of the canvas height (larger with 3 lines, smaller with 4), 3-4 stacked lines, left-aligned, maximum contrast against the flat background (white on dark or near-black on light); the single key word set in the brand accent color or on an accent marker swipe
text_layers.guia_texto: Una afirmación de 3 a 7 palabras que rompa el patrón: una frase provocadora, una verdad incómoda o una confesión, según el ángulo. Afirmación, no pregunta. Debe entenderse sola, sin imagen. Indica 1 palabra clave (la que carga la emoción) para resaltarla.

text_layers.reference_position: Bottom-left footer zone, aligned with the headline's left edge
text_layers.text_style: Regular or medium weight sans-serif, about 3-3.5% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, max about 50% of the canvas width; same color as the headline at slightly lower opacity or the secondary palette color
text_layers.guia_texto: Remata el titular conectándolo con el producto (qué es o qué resuelve) en 5 a 10 palabras.

mandatory_visual_elements: Giant left-aligned headline filling 60-70% of the canvas in 3-4 stacked lines
One key word highlighted with the brand accent color or a marker swipe
The user's product, small, in the bottom-right corner with a soft contact shadow
forbidden_additions: Subheadline block directly under the headline
Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
People, lifestyle scenes or background photos
Decorative shapes, stickers, arrows or emojis
notas_paleta: Paleta de marca, aplicada de forma muy gráfica: fondo plano con el color principal (o el más intenso u oscuro de la paleta); titular en el color de mayor contraste (blanco o casi negro); el color de acento solo para la palabra clave o su trazo de resaltado. Máximo 3 colores en total en el lienzo, sin contar el producto.
